title: Shot-Chart Spatial Embeddings for NBA Feature Engine
summary: Add shot-chart spatial embeddings as a new feature category (Cat38) to the NBA engine. Research shows spatial shooting patterns provide complementary information beyond team-level statistics. Ablation study: removing shot-chart embeddings decreases both discrimination and calibration significantly.

research_basis.paper: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
research_basis.finding: LSTM + Monte Carlo dropout with shot-chart spatial embeddings outperforms all tabular baselines on Brier score. Ablation confirms shot-chart is the key differentiator vs team-level stats alone.
research_basis.model_type: LSTM+MC_dropout (not feasible on CPU islands) but spatial features ARE tabular-extractable
research_basis.cpu_adaptation: Extract spatial summary stats per team-game from play-by-play: zone frequencies, expected value by zone, shot selection pressure index

implementation_plan.step_1: Add Cat38 to features/engine.py: shot_zone_freq_paint, shot_zone_freq_midrange, shot_zone_freq_corner3, shot_zone_freq_above_break3
implementation_plan.step_2: For each team-game: compute % of shots from each zone (using play-by-play / shot_chart data from balldontlie.io or nba_api)
implementation_plan.step_3: Add spatial_ev_paint, spatial_ev_midrange, spatial_ev_corner3 (expected value per zone = FG% * pts)
implementation_plan.step_4: Add shot_selection_pressure: how much team deviates from league avg in each zone (z-score per zone)
implementation_plan.step_5: Add opponent_shot_quality_allowed: same metrics for shots ALLOWED (defensive spatial profile)
implementation_plan.step_6: Add rolling_shot_quality_diff_5g: 5-game trend in shot quality differential

cpu_feasibility: HIGH — all features are simple zone-level aggregations, no CV/embedding models needed on CPU islands
data_availability: MEDIUM — requires play-by-play shot location data. nba_api.stats has this but rate-limited. Can batch-compute offline and store.
cross_project_relevance: LOW — basketball-specific, no direct political alpha port

comparison_to_existing.synergy: Cat37+Cat38 together captures BOTH momentum AND shot quality — complementary dimensions
comparison_to_existing.risk: Requires new data pipeline for shot chart data. If data unavailable, compute from box score proxies (3PA/FGA ratio as corner3 proxy, FTA/FGA as paint proxy)

fallback_features_from_boxscore.paint_proxy: FTA_rate = FTA / FGA (high FTA = getting to paint)
fallback_features_from_boxscore.corner3_proxy: Not directly available from box score — skip or estimate

next_step: VM Muscle to compute Cat38 features from existing data, add to engine.py, deploy via deploy_island.py to S15 (wide search, best for new feature exploration)
